items.title: DoorDash (DASH) Stock Looks Overvalued Following Its 90% Three Year Run
items.summary: DoorDash is back in the spotlight after a mixed run in the share price and a headline acquisition plan. The live question is whether the current valuation can be justified by what the company earns today versus what it might earn in the future. Over the past 3 years, DoorDash shares have gained about 90.1%, which puts a lot of weight on the idea that the business can grow into the expectations now embedded in its valuation.
